notes: CTF position operations per the official positions-management page: split (pUSD -> complete outcome-token set), merge (balanced set -> pUSD), redeem (winning tokens -> pUSD after resolution). Contract addresses are the PUBLIC Polygon addresses published on the source page (public on-chain addresses, not credentials). On-chain functions splitPosition/mergePositions/redeemPositions share the parameter pattern (collateralToken, parentCollectionId, conditionId, partition|indexSets, amount). SDK methods splitPosition()/mergePositions()/redeemPositions() return a TransactionOutcome awaited via transaction.wait(); the official page types it as outcome.transactionHash: TxHash and outcome.transactionId: TransactionId | null (Python: outcome.transaction_id: str | None), so transactionId MAY BE NULL and a consumer must not assume a relayer id exists (re-verified 2026-08-26; the 'redeem-outcome-null-transaction-id' example freezes the null form). Transaction hashes/ids in examples are synthetic. Additional source: https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/ctf/overview (position-id derivation, neg-risk conversion).

payload.description: Public Polygon contract addresses published by the official docs on 2026-08-24; re-verify at WP-300 implementation time.
Convert pUSD into a complete YES/NO outcome-token set; every pair is backed by exactly $1 of locked collateral.
payload.onchain_function: splitPosition(address collateralToken, bytes32 parentCollectionId, bytes32 conditionId, uint256[] partition, uint256 amount)

payload.description: Convert a balanced YES/NO outcome-token set back into pUSD.
payload.onchain_function: mergePositions(address collateralToken, bytes32 parentCollectionId, bytes32 conditionId, uint256[] partition, uint256 amount)

payload.description: Claim pUSD for winning outcome tokens after market resolution.
payload.onchain_function: redeemPositions(address collateralToken, bytes32 parentCollectionId, bytes32 conditionId, uint256[] indexSets)

payload.description: Redeem whose TransactionOutcome carries a null transactionId; the official page types it as TransactionId | null, so a consumer must not assume a relayer id exists.
payload.onchain_function: redeemPositions(address collateralToken, bytes32 parentCollectionId, bytes32 conditionId, uint256[] indexSets)
